audioNegativeControls.control: muted native channels still report playing

notes: Native builds, compression and other browser tests were terminal before both final runs of each benchmark. Background host services remain; this is not an isolated physical device.

The render-target fixture originally used 32 batches, producing below-resolution submission samples. Both exploratory runs remain under .cache/sdl-focus/targets-first.json and targets-second.json. The published pair uses 1024 batches and has no zero submission samples.

Render controls independently suppress draws, depth rejection, the second MRT output or resolve; every control fails full-image verification after a validated opposite-color starting frame. The control loops use 32 batches; the final measurement repeats the same checked operation 1024 times.
Audio PCM amplitude scales with 1/8/32 native channels. Muting them preserves native playing counts but fails the signal guard, ruling out a counter-only success.
Mixing memory remains at 51 SDL allocations and 3745008 live bytes after warmup and every round, on both runs. Explicit shutdown reaches zero and closes the audio context/disconnects the processor.

After PHP refresh, two SDL allocations reappear and SDL_GetError reports Invalid audio device ID. Four successive refreshes preserve the count. Source points to request shutdown calling Mix_HaltMusic/Mix_LockAudio on a closed device. This is a separate cleanup/error-state audit item, not evidence of growing playback allocations.
